faqs.q: Will I receive all five Panchakarma procedures?
faqs.a: Panchakarma procedures are not a checklist that every guest receives. Ask which procedures are proposed for you, why they are recommended and what alternatives are available before agreeing to a treatment plan.

faqs.q: How do I know whether this programme is suitable for me?
faqs.a: Share your diagnosis, current symptoms and goals before admission. Discuss any heart or kidney disease, pregnancy, recent surgery or previous reactions to cleansing procedures so the physician can assess suitability.

faqs.q: Can I continue my prescribed medicines?
faqs.a: Do not stop or change prescribed medicines on your own. Share a complete list of medicines and supplements with your treating clinicians and discuss any proposed Ayurvedic medicines with them.

faqs.q: What should I discuss with the physician before treatment?
faqs.a: Your consultation is an opportunity to understand the proposed treatment, its expected benefits, possible side effects and available alternatives. Share any concerns with your physician and keep the care team informed about how you feel during treatment.

faqs.q: What results can I realistically expect, and how long should I stay?
faqs.a: Treatment goals and the recommended duration of admission depend on your condition and the physician’s assessment. Your physician will discuss expected progress and review your response during treatment. Individual outcomes vary.

faqs.q: Can a companion stay with me?
faqs.a: Companion stays are considered case by case. Share your accommodation and assistance needs before admission so the team can confirm availability, arrangements and applicable charges.

faqs.q: What follow-up is included after discharge?
faqs.a: Your care includes four remote follow-up consultations with your treating physician within one year after discharge. Please schedule each appointment with your doctor; consultation dates are not fixed when you leave.

faqs.q: Do I need to submit medical reports before admission?
faqs.a: Pre-admission medical reports and physician clearance are required only for severe conditions, on a case-by-case basis. The team will confirm whether they are needed for your admission.

faqs.q: What support is available if I need help getting around or with daily activities?
faqs.a: Routine assistance, such as help walking or travelling by wheelchair between your room and the treatment centre, is available without requiring a dedicated attendant. If you need dedicated nursing or attendant support, this can be arranged at an additional cost based on the level of assistance required. Please share your needs before admission so the team can confirm suitable arrangements and charges.

faqs.a: Your weight-management goals depend on your starting health, medical history and individual needs. Discuss achievable goals with your physician and how progress will be assessed, including changes beyond body weight. Individual results vary.
